measure_before_source_publication: CPU producer: builder, unchanged independent _validate_inventory reconstruction, full JSON publication/marker hashing and guards separately. Original oracle is hash-to-sink, not a saved inventory; one actual file materialization is a distinct purpose, not a repeat reference/equivalence claim. Never retarget a running oracle job.

Cold and warm existing-format reader: all completion/reference scans, same-buffer payload hash, strict parse, metadata/input matching and _freeze_json separately; actual disk bytes/read counts, CPU/wall and cgroup current/peak/events.

Entry and final backing checks: actual object_reference/_complete scans. Existing witnesses rehash full bytes, including when size/mtime are restored. Measure exact refresh count; never call this cheap stat validation.

Pilot inventory reading/reconstruction, original live root/source/protection/budget/lease checks, actual model load, actual post-load geometry, selected backing load, and immutable proof retention remain part of in-allocation cost.

Tiny numerical comparison exercises original versus prepared paths with unchanged control values/scopes; genuine metadata loading on the intended CPU/storage family is separate from tiny numeric correctness.

Full selected remaining target cannot be prepared until original M2 fit/capture/validation and complete CPU selection exist. Its byte size/load/freeze/host peak is unmeasured; no fabricated early selected artifact.
RAM_and_storage: Raw11GB payload, decoded JSON with lost alias sharing, frozen copies, model staging and numeric proof data may coexist. Do not infer a lower peak from preallocation. Preserve all conservative full-target/M2 tiers and shared-pool capacity rules; initial M1 metadata-load RAM must be measured separately.
timing_accounting: Keep original A3_WRAPPER_START_SECONDS/process start and min(initial,current) lease. Loading/hashing/freezing/guards before model load remain charged to GPU allocation and startup accounting; do not reset the timer at load_model. CPU-only construction is outside GPU allocation but is reported as CPU cost.

paired_budget.postchange_requirement: Both parts load/hash/parse/freeze + fresh guards + both model startups + actual forwards/controls/packing/serialization/reconciliation/publication + both finish reserves <=1800, with actual host/storage capacities. Removing construction/publication is not proof this holds.

paired_dependency: Initial prefit must not consume the whole allowance and strand selected timing. Actual selected preparation follows M2; before first timing spend root still needs a defensible conservative paired bound or a separately approved sequencing/budget decision. CPU tiny cases are not H200 timing measurements.

alternatives.name: Status quo
alternatives.tradeoff: No new trust seam, but the observed build alone nearly exhausts the pair and late publication/readback adds substantial uncosted work. Current evidence does not demonstrate feasibility.

alternatives.name: This prepared-data design
alternatives.tradeoff: Moves deterministic build/reconstruction/publication before allocation, using existing artifacts and a sealed data reader. Requires explicit root data-authentication trust, alias/RAM/reader-cost evidence and fresh numerical gates; no guard-result caching.

alternatives.name: User-approved budget amendment
alternatives.tradeoff: May retain the slower source if complete paired cost and RAM/storage needs are acceptable. Requires explicit user authority; no cap transfer/refund/extra time is granted here, and more time does not fix RAM.
